identification: Rough-sawn live-edge Tasmanian timber slab, about 2 m long, long and narrow with a tapering top and bark on both edges, catalogued as Huon pine. Pale yellow, very close even growth lines consistent with Huon pine or celery-top pine; species not confirmable from photos. Sits between lots 1115 and 1117 which are similar slabs from the same run.

entries.note: Page opened. Prices accepted in past tenders for raw Huon pine craft logs and pieces, not sawn slabs and not retail. A 2 m x 0.3 m x 0.05 m slab is about 0.03 m3, so raw material value about $35 to $130 before milling and drying. Retail dressed Huon pine sells for much more per m3 but I found no verified retail slab listing. No aud rate needed (AUD). aud_price 0 means not a per-item price.

searches_tried: comps.py (pipeline and work) with 'huon pine slab' and 'huon pine' (about 1,200 Gowans/Armitage hits, no non-local sold slab comps); direct fetch of Island Specialty Timbers tender price archive (opened). WebSearch was refused because the search budget was used up, so no web search for dealer retail (Tasmanian timber yards, Huon pine slab retail), other auction houses or eBay was possible. eBay sold listings for 'huon pine slab' would settle resale and need Chrome.
chrome_hint: eBay Australia, Sold items: huon pine slab (also huon pine live edge slab, huon pine board 2m); compare with Tasmanian timber dealer retail listings for Huon pine slabs per m3.
viewing_check: Smell the cut face (Huon pine has a strong sweet oily aroma, celery-top and kauri do not), look at the end grain for tight rings, measure length, width and thickness, and check for splits, rot or worm. Photograph the edge thickness.
